title: Safe Inference-Time Alignment via Lagrangian Reward Augmentation
abstract: arXiv:2607.02781v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Inference-time alignment steers a frozen language model during decoding using auxiliary reward signals, avoiding the cost of repeated weight updates. However, existing inference-time alignment methods typically optimize a single scalar score, so explicit safety constraints must either be ignored or encoded through manually tuned penalties. We propose Lagrangian Reward Augmentation (LARA), a general inference-time alignment framework under safety constraints. Starting from a KL-regularized constrained objective with a reward model and a cost model, LARA dualizes the constraint and reduces the optimization problem to a one-dimensional convex problem over a nonnegative dual variable. Estimated on a small calibration set, this dual variable defines an augmented reward that can be used as a drop-in scoring signal within existing inference-time alignment methods. translated_title: 基于拉格朗日奖励增强的安全推理时对齐
translated_abstract: 推理时对齐在解码过程中利用辅助奖励信号来引导冻结的语言模型，从而避免了反复更新权重的高昂代价。然而，现有的推理时对齐方法通常只优化单一的标量分数，因此显式的安全约束要么被忽略，要么只能通过手工调整的惩罚项来编码。我们提出了拉格朗日奖励增强（LARA），一个在安全约束下的通用推理时对齐框架。从包含奖励模型和代价模型的KL正则化约束目标出发，LARA对约束进行对偶化，将优化问题化为关于一个非负对偶变量的一维凸问题。该对偶变量通过一个小型校准集估计得到，并由其定义的增强奖励可作为现有推理时对齐方法中即插即用的评分信号。对于序列级采样方法，例如Best-of-N重排序，该……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出LARA框架，通过拉格朗日对偶将安全约束转化为由小型校准集估计的对偶变量所定义的增强奖励，实现可即插即用于现有推理时对齐方法的无需权重更新的安全对齐。
en_tdlr: LARA dualizes explicit safety constraints into an augmented reward defined by a dual variable estimated on a small calibration set, enabling drop-in safe inference-time alignment of frozen language models without weight updates.
